name: yap
description: Good ideas, made REEL. A collaborative short video planning workspace.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace=@yap/contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@yap/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@yap/contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@yap/api
scripts.check:showcase: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/motion.js && node --test tests/*.test.js
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@yap/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@yap/api
scripts.typecheck:api: npm run typecheck --workspace=@yap/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@yap/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build --workspace=@yap/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@yap/api && npm run test --workspace=@yap/contracts
scripts.test:promo-ui: npm run build --workspace=@yap/contracts && node --import tsx --test apps/web/test/*.test.ts
scripts.smoke:promo-ui: npm run build --workspace=@yap/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/test-promo-ui.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@yap/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --import tsx --test apps/web/test/*.test.ts && npm run check:showcase
